name: Agentic Kanban Worker

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 * * * *' # run hourly

env:
  GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}
  GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  agentic-worker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --workspace --all-features

      - name: Run agentic worker
        run: |
          echo "Running agentic worker"
          # Placeholder for actual agentic worker script
          # e.g., ./scripts/agentic_worker.sh
          # The script should use $GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN and $GITHUB_TOKEN
        env:
          GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
